instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Ensure the app adheres to dark modern tech aesthetics (#06080D background) with cyan and emerald accents.
2. All interactive components must include explicit 'data-testid' attributes for reliable E2E automated test runs.
3. Overwrite or update files in /app/frontend/src cleanly with proper modular components (Navbar, Hero, ServicesBento, Calculator, BookingWizard, Testimonials, Footer).

4. Ensure the Multi-step Booking Wizard handles step transitions smoothly and culminates in generating a fully formatted WhatsApp link with all key booking details, while also saving the booking to the MongoDB database via FastAPI.
5. Ensure responsive grid layouts (mobile first grid-cols-1 up to grid-cols-12 on desktop).
6. Never rely on default transparent dropdowns; always set dark opaque/glass background colors (`bg-[#0C1017]` or `bg-[#121824]`) with solid contrast text.
7. Include simulated initial availability slots in the calendar picker for smooth user testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use dark colors as soft pastel gradients; use crisp dark obsidian surfaces with neon/cyan stroke highlights.
Every hoverable card must have micro-interactions (subtle translate-y, glowing border transition, scale effect).
Keep text hierarchy clear with generous padding and spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12).
Include tests and test attributes (`data-testid`) across buttons, inputs, modals, category cards, calendar days, time slots, and submit buttons.
